verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets users type natural-language questions and commands ('draft and send a follow-up email', 'draft and send a Slack message', 'find a time and create a Google Calendar event') that trigger real actions from meeting context, and Recipes let users save reusable NL prompt templates — this is a first-party, built-in agentic NL command interface, not just an external MCP/API integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these chat-driven actions (email/Slack/calendar) reliably execute as described, and more detail on the breadth of supported commands beyond the few documented examples.
